label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (xss): alert-FP. Traced data flow: request.getHeaderNames() -> param (header name) -> doSomething() -> bar (first word of header name) -> input -> new String(input) -> encodeForHTML() -> response.getWriter(). The resolved sink value is attacker-controlled header name data, BUT it is properly sanitized by ESAPI.encodeForHTML() before HTML output. Balanced encoding is applied between source and sink, rendering the XSS vulnerability ineffective. The encoding at the sink expression (lines 99-105) mitigates the reported vulnerability.

evidence.note: User-controlled header name captured into param variable
doSomething() extracts first word of header name into bar
Sink: encodeForHTML() applied to input before HTML output, providing balanced encoding mitigation
